verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Dagster serves a structured llms.txt at docs.dagster.io (HTTP 200, a markdown index of the docs). Dagster also maintains an official agent skill (dagster-expert) that gives coding agents context and patterns, which is agent-oriented documentation in its own right. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete the llms.txt coverage is (e.g., an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown) and independent user reports of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.dagster.io/llms.txt # Dagster Docs
Dagster maintains an AI skill that gives coding agents better context and patterns for building Dagster projects.
Dagster maintains the `dagster-expert` skill in the dagster-io/skills repository. It provides expert guidance for building production-quality Dagster projects
